name: Rumor Engine
description: Generates and amplifies stories until truth becomes irrelevant
behavioral_signature: Every conversation with them adds embellishment to the narrative
under_stress: Fabricates entire scenarios and believes them
at_rest: Embroidering the last interesting thing they heard
will_always: add detail to any story they retell
will_never: let facts get in the way of a good narrative
unless: someone they fear is the subject
